cohort: 1663 term singleton pregnancies with cephalic presentation at gestational age 37+0 weeks and beyond in Norway
finding: 10% of inductions were elective, with 86% resulting in vaginal delivery, and there was no significant difference in cesarean section rates between elective and medically indicated induction groups.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rate was 14% in the elective induction group and 17% in the medically indicated group (OR = 0.8, 95% CI 0.5-1.3).
